calibration.name: Mantis shape-diverse neural readout

validation.units: Normalized center coordinates x/y; height as a fraction of391pixels
validation.error_denominator: Every predeclared held-out observation, no selective abstention

calibration.prediction_inputs: Eight actual neural features only; no target geometry or evaluator truth
calibration.training_scope: Synthetic rectangle geometry; no recorded actor flight or benchmark data

calibration_independent_verification.scope: Independent fit, split, metrics, loader and hashes; no neural inference or full-activity reconstruction
notes: Repeated held poses and recurrent sequences are correlated; metrics are descriptive sample errors, not independent confidence bounds.
Full activity-to-feature reconstruction is outside this independent audit; implementer provided a separate full reconstruction receipt.
Selection improves synthetic cue reconstruction over the previous readout only; no advantage over direct geometry or conventional filtering follows.
Freeze ordering is supported by frozen source control flow and local artifact timestamps, not externally timestamped attestation.

limits: Offline simulation with a stylized animated actor and ideal registered depth/state.
Same-view capture-time bearing comparisons do not establish overall controller superiority.
Synthetic cue-decoder improvement does not prove a neural advantage over conventional guidance.
No physical flight, general person identity, real-time operation or obstacle detours demonstrated.
Full raw recordings and downloaded upstream weights are retained locally, not bundled.
